Cain. * Full text (40 Ko) * Red and blue only * Red only

     Chiococca racemosa. Rubiaceæ.

     Introduced in 1826 as a specific for dropsy by Martius and Langsdorf from Brazil ; later found useless in hydrops, and injurious in post- scarlatinal dropsy.

     In 1843 proved by Buchner and several others, who got the genuine root from Martius himself, and published the provings in the British Quarterly, then in Buchner's (Nusser's) A. Z. f. H. II, appendix, p. 141-144. Proved by Lippe, in Carlisle, in 1845 ; by Isaac Draper in Phila., in 1850.

     The collection made by Roth was translated by J. W. Metcalf and published with additions in 1852 in the New York Quarterly.
